exceptions.title: does not focus the input when pressing content in a nested React portal
exceptions.reason: React sends the press of a portal up the React tree, so the chips get it. A Vue press goes up the DOM only, and a `Teleport` puts its content outside the chips. The chips thus get no such press.

exceptions.title: does not link Combobox.Label to trigger before hydration
exceptions.reason: The case renders on a server only. Vase UI links the label in the server HTML (VUE-51). The case "VUE-51: names the trigger with a label that comes before it" asserts that link. The case "names the trigger that comes before it" of `ComboboxLabel.node.test.tsx` asserts it for a label after the trigger.

exceptions.title: does not dismiss when pressing portalled content inside the popup but outside the list
exceptions.reason: React sends the press of a portal up the React tree, so the popup knows that the press is inside it. A Vue press goes up the DOM only, and a `Teleport` puts its content outside the popup. The popup thus gets no such press.

exceptions.title: does not navigate the list with arrow keys from portalled controls inside the popup
exceptions.reason: React sends the key of a portal up the React tree, so the list could get it. A Vue key goes up the DOM only, and a `Teleport` puts its content outside the list. The list thus gets no such key.
